notes: TBox, as geography-replace-0005: each well-known member's class membership and its stored form are separate background facts; a stored world gives up the membership and adds the wider, unedited class the record's summary moves it to (a firm rule giving the original form), a rule world gives up the stored form. The record's 'wider rule that the edited rule overrides for its class' is a default (specific beats general) and is not expressible, so it is left out here; the delete mirror encodes it with the class link that the delete cuts. The four derived queries ask which verb form the subject takes: a find through the functional takes_verb_form (the sentence choices are surfaces of the singular and plural verb individuals); the prompts' new subjects are given as members of the edited class. Relabelled dl on 2026-10-31 (COVERAGE.md label corrections: choosing the sentence is choosing the subject's one number value, no comparison beyond that); the fol section keeps its Z3 encoding as a second check.

fol.notes: Agreement as the subject's grammatical_number (enum Number): the sentence choice is a find on it, each candidate sentence a surface of its number in 'choices'. The rule over the class is a finite quantifier over the record's subjects. Fact ids follow the DL file. Replace: a stored world gives up the phrase's membership and adds the wider, unedited class it moves to (a firm rule giving the original form); a rule world gives up the stored form.
